Peter Ing | Peter A. Ing (born April 28, 1969) is a former National Hockey League goaltender, who played for the Toronto Maple Leafs from 1989 to 1991.  Ing was born in Toronto of mixed ancestry, his father was Chinese.
Domi Trastoy Díaz | Domi Trastoy Diaz (Sant Julia de Loria, Andorra, born January 25, 1981) is an Andorran mountaineer who already completed five out of the seven highest summits of each continent.  On 22 May 2013 he completed the ascent of the Everest summit, the highest summit in Nepal and in the world.
